understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle colors orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates only when all three attributes match, and completing all goals advances to the next level; losing all lives ends the game.
